flagged.title: UK Landscapes & Geomorphic Processes
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly claims the Pennines are made of granite contrasting with softer Carboniferous rocks (when the Pennines have no surface granite and are composed of Carboniferous limestone and Millstone Grit), which will mislead students on UK geology and lose marks.

mark_affecting.quote: Well, it's because they're made of tough granite and limestone that can withstand the natural elements far better than the much softer Carboniferous rocks sitting in the lowlands right next to them.

In 2023, the UK's net migration... was roughly 685,000. That is a record figure.
